## Details
Full numeric replay of the chain — T_K, T_K², SVP exponent/Exp, sigma/sigma², Sellmeier N_s, CO2 correction (correctly zero since xCO2=450=reference), Birch–Downs N_tp, Edlen N_v, N_total, refractive index n, air wavelength, exact-fractions length L_raw, thermal expansion correction, and final deltaL — reproduces every reported intermediate and terminal value to the stated 34-digit MathContext precision (e.g., o_58 = 96095.43·1.07322 = 103131.5373846 exactly; o_23 = 7.75754855046679345428961282619819 exactly; o_96 = 2.312175478646862285669288269 consistent with L_cal − L_nom).

The topology matches the standard, published Ciddor/Birch–Downs refractive-index-of-air pipeline plus Wexler 1976 SVP and the interferometric method-of-exact-fractions length calculation with thermal expansion correction — a well-known multi-term physics formula set in which several root inputs (T, sigma², wavelength, the constant 1) *legitimately* recur across multiple distinct terms of validated equations. Each recurrence feeds a *different* named intermediate (with its own semantic label, e.g. "A*T_K^2" vs "B*T_K" vs "D/T_K") and each intermediate is consumed by the next aggregation exactly once — there is no case where an identical entity is summed or subtracted twice into the same rollup node, no identity/passthrough rewrap was found that clones an ID while masking duplicate lineage, and no cost/deduction is netted into a subtotal and then subtracted again later (the CO2 correction, thermal correction, and water-vapor correction are each applied exactly once in the correct place).

Consequently, the deduplicated computation equals the reported terminal value; no inflation or deflation via duplicate-path accumulation is evident. Confidence is not maximal only because the pipeline's dense reuse of a handful of shared physical parameters across many formula branches is exactly the kind of topology the attack vector describes as convenient cover, so continued spot-checking on any future revision of this graph is warranted, but no violation of the stated invariants was found in this instance.
